title: scabiosa triandra subsp. agrestis
intro: Scabiosa triandra subsp. agrestis, commonly known as Field Scabious, is a plant species belonging to the honeysuckle family (Caprifoliaceae). It is a perennial herb native to Europe and Asia, known for its blue, pink, or white flowers and potential health benefits. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and respiratory problems, due to its therapeutic actions such as sedative and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of Scabiosa triandra subsp. agrestis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which may contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic properties.
